name: SoftBody3D
description: Adds a behavior-based 3D soft body mesh simulator. It deforms Three.js mesh vertices with spring constraints, reads GDevelop/Jolt 3D physics world gravity when available, and exposes actions for impulses, pins, stiffness, pressure, and rebuilding.
author: Christopher Monhollen

eventsBasedBehaviors.name: SoftBody3D
eventsBasedBehaviors.description: Deform a low-poly 3D object mesh with a soft body spring solver. Optionally add a normal 3D physics behavior so this behavior can follow the Jolt physics world gravity.

properties.name: IncludeChildren
properties.label: Include Child Meshes
properties.description: Deform all child meshes under the object.

properties.name: MaxVertices
properties.label: Max Vertices
properties.description: Safety limit for mesh vertices. Use low-poly meshes.

properties.name: ShapeRetention
properties.label: Shape Retention
properties.description: How strongly the mesh keeps its original shape.

properties.name: UsePhysicsWorldGravity
properties.label: Use Physics World Gravity
properties.description: Use gravity from the GDevelop 3D physics world when available.

properties.name: GroundLevel
properties.label: Ground Level
properties.description: Local coordinate of the ground plane.

properties.name: CollisionPadding
properties.label: Collision Padding
properties.description: Extra distance above the ground plane.

properties.name: PinMode
properties.label: Pin Mode
properties.description: Pinned vertices stay at their original local mesh positions.

properties.name: GroundAxis
properties.label: Ground Axis
properties.description: Local axis used by ground-plane collision.

properties.name: Physics3D
properties.label: 3D Physics Behavior
properties.description: Optional normal 3D physics behavior used to read GDevelop/Jolt world gravity.

eventsFunctions.name: SetEnabled
eventsFunctions.sentence: Set soft body enabled for _PARAM0_ _PARAM1_ to _PARAM2_
eventsFunctions.description: Enable or disable soft body simulation.

eventsFunctions.name: ResetSoftBody
eventsFunctions.description: Reset every point to its original mesh position.

eventsFunctions.name: RebuildSoftBody
eventsFunctions.description: Rebuild particles and springs from current mesh geometry.

eventsFunctions.name: ApplyImpulse
eventsFunctions.description: Add velocity to every unpinned point.

eventsFunctions.name: ApplyImpulseAtPoint
eventsFunctions.description: Push points near a local mesh-space position.

eventsFunctions.name: NativeJoltSoftBodyAvailable
eventsFunctions.fullName: Native Jolt soft bodies are available
eventsFunctions.sentence: Native Jolt soft bodies are available for _PARAM0_ _PARAM1_
eventsFunctions.description: Check whether this GDevelop build exposes native Jolt soft body constructors to JavaScript.
